filter_lcov_branch_data: filter an lcov trace file to keep only branch data for lines containing preprocessor conditionals
skip_c_comments: create a generator that strips single-line and multi-line C-style comments from source code lines
find_conditional_lines: build a generator that finds line numbers containing preprocessor if conditionals in source code
cond_lines_from_file: create a function that reads a source file and yields line numbers of preprocessor conditionals
review_filter_lcov_trace: review the filter_lcov_trace function that filters branch coverage data by source file conditionals
